steps.body: Adding a one-digit number to a two-digit number works the same way as adding small numbers: start at the bigger number and count on.
steps.narration: Adding a one-digit number to a two-digit number works the same way as adding small numbers: start at the bigger number and count on.

widget.prompt: Start at 34. Count on 2. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 34 and count on 2: you land on 36.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 36 — counting on 2 from 34 gives 36.

predict.prompt: You start at 34 and count on 2. Which way do you move?
predict.reveal: Counting ON always moves up the number line, toward bigger numbers.
